description.value:
You turn your gestalt polymorph energy inward, dissolving your solid body into an animated mass of thick, viscous liquid that retains your mass and volume but becomes fully amorphous. While in Fluid Form you can Squeeze through any gap at least 1 inch wide without needing to succeed at an Acrobatics check. You gain resistance 10 to physical damage from non-magical weapons. You have immunity to poison, and you are immune to the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Paralyzed]{Paralyzed} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned]{Stunned} conditions. Your Speed becomes 20 feet, and you gain a 20-foot swim Speed.

While in Fluid Form you cannot speak, cast spells, or make Strikes. You cannot use manipulate actions that require hands. If the spell ends while you are in a space too small for your normal form, you are automatically expelled to the nearest unoccupied space large enough to contain you; if no such space is within 30 feet, you are squeezed out over 1 round and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute from the traumatic reconstitution.

You can Dismiss this spell as a 2-action activity.

Heightened (6th) The resistance increases to 15 and you also gain resistance 10 to acid damage. You can flow up walls and across ceilings, gaining a 20-foot climb Speed.
